1. The center of the circle is marked at \((1,-2)\).
2. The top of the circle is at \((1,1)\).
3. The radius is the distance from the center to the top of the circle:
\[
r=\left|1-(-2)\right|=3.
\]

(The dashed segment to \((-2,0)\) does not reach the circle, so it is not a radius.)

\[
\boxed{3}
\]
